## How it was tested

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated

## Checklist

- [ ] No secrets, tokens, `.env` files or participant data in the diff
- [ ] No personal data of minors logged or sent to third-party services
- [ ] Strings are translatable (no hard-coded user-facing text)
- [ ] Accessibility: 48dp touch targets, contrast checked, colour is never the only signal
